trees.name: Lagerstroemia indica L.
trees.leaf_evidence: deciduous (LDL: UF/IFAS ST342 'deciduous', autumn colour yellow/orange/red); Cairo leaf-drop and leaf-out months: GAP (no Egypt source found)

pruned.source_status: READ AS SEARCH EXCERPT 2026-11-22 (page itself not fetched); tolerance to a held 3.4 m crown is INFERENCE from 'pollarding keeps a plant at a set height'

trees.decision: PICKED over the dining: deciduous, graded B asset, benign roots, high heat, tolerates alkaline soil, non-toxic, summer flowers (Jul-Sep: the summer evenings), pruning regime sourced (UF/IFAS EP399, excerpt). NHBC fits only at the pruned height.

trees.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia D.Don
trees.leaf_evidence: deciduous or semi-deciduous (LDL, NCSU: flowers while leafless); UF/IFAS ST317 excerpt: blooms April-August, sometimes before the new leaves; a Zambian guide gives leaf fall July-August (southern hemisphere: NOT used); Cairo months: GAP
trees.decision: REJECTED for these gardens: graded A and deciduous, but 15.2 m mature height needs 7.6 m from the house (low water) and the sourced minimum spread 4.6 m will not fit; no source on holding it at 4.5 m; messy (leaf and flower litter). Fits a larger plot.

trees.name: Delonix regia (Bojer ex Hook.) Raf.
trees.decision: REJECTED: graded A, but alkaline soil intolerant (LDL), aggressive shallow roots that lift walls, 18 m.

trees.name: Punica granatum L.
trees.leaf_evidence: deciduous (LDL: NCSU, SelecTree); Cairo months: GAP
trees.decision: KEPT as the understorey fruit tree (graded B, deciduous, benign roots); too small to roof a seat (spread 2.4-3.0 m) and NHBC moderate x 3.7 m = 2.8 m cannot fit the east yard (2.3 m to the house wall).

trees.name: Ficus carica L.
trees.decision: REJECTED: deciduous and fruiting but not drawable, alkaline soil intolerant (LDL) in a site of unknown soil pH, suckers; wet-fruit litter.

trees.name: Tipuana tipu (Benth.) Kuntze
trees.leaf_evidence: semi-evergreen, 'largely deciduous midwinter to spring depending on site' (LDL, Wikipedia excerpt): the only sourced drop window, and it runs into the hot months
trees.decision: REJECTED: its leaf-drop window (midwinter to spring) is sourced but leaves the hot early spring bare; large (30 m), invasive flag, alkaline intolerant.

trees.name: Olea europaea L.

pruned.source_status: GAP: no source on olive tolerance of an umbrella-held crown was found (search 2026-11-22 returned none)

trees.decision: PICKED where year-round screening matters (quiet bench, east yard bench) and winter sun is already small: evergreen, low water (NHBC 0.5), roots moderate; stand-in asset only (grade C); NO source on umbrella pruning (GAP, stated).

trees.name: Ficus microcarpa L.fil.
trees.decision: REJECTED: densest shade but aggressive roots (LDL): needs 6 m (policy) from a pond or building: no position in the 5.7 m x 9.3 m garden or the courts; invasive flag; ('Nitida' clipping tolerance is well attested in trade sources, not used).

trees.name: Citrus × limon (L.) Osbeck
trees.decision: REJECTED as a shade tree: light shade, 6.1 m, hydrozone high (needs its own bed), thorny; graded A, fine as a fruit tree elsewhere.

trees.name: melia azedarach
trees.decision: no LDL record, no graded asset; no Cairo leaf-month source found (street-tree surveys of Greater Cairo exist but the excerpts read give no phenology); not evaluated

trees.name: bauhinia variegata
trees.decision: no LDL record, no graded asset; no leaf-month source found; not evaluated

trees.name: morus alba
trees.decision: no LDL record, no graded asset; fruit stains paving (not tested); no leaf-month source found; not evaluated

trees.name: ceratonia siliqua
trees.decision: no LDL record (large evergreen, brief names it); not evaluated
